sanskrit_verse:
राजा नाम चरत्येष भूमौ साक्षात् सहस्रदृक् ।
न तस्याज्ञामतिक्रम्य संतिष्ठेरन् प्रजाः क्वचित् ॥
transliteration: rājā nāma caraty eṣa bhūmau sākṣāt sahasradṛk | na tasyājñām atikramya saṃtiṣṭheran prajāḥ kvacit ||
sph_interpretive_translation: The King, by name and embodiment, moves directly upon the earth as the thousand-eyed witness; none of his subjects may transgress his command and remain established anywhere.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is inherent in the sovereign's direct perceptual capacity
Causation arises from the unbroken alignment between command and consciousness
Capacity-based responsibility is proportional to the subject's ability to perceive and respond to dharma
Restoration logic operates through immediate realignment with the sovereign's witnessing presence
Consciousness alignment occurs when subjects recognize the omnipresent authority of dharma
executable_legal_axioms: IF a subject perceives the sovereign's command AND disobeys THEN consciousness misalignment occurs AND restoration protocol initiates automatically
IF ajna (command) is issued by raja THEN all prajas MUST align within witnessed field ELSE jurisdictional coherence dissolves
IF any praja remains in disobedience THEN systemic integration fails AND corrective alignment pathways activate
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that the threshold of responsibility lies not in intent or action alone but in the conscious recognition of the sovereign's witnessing capacity. The court must ensure that its judgments reflect this ontological hierarchy where disobedience disrupts societal integration, necessitating realignments rather than punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramana-based causality confirms that the king's vision encompasses all actions without exception. Disobedience disrupts sequential manifestation (anupurvasah) of social harmony. Responsibility is proportional to one's capacity to perceive the sovereign’s command. Thus, justice is non-punitive because it restores alignment through recognition, not through imposition of suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process for subject to fully perceive and acknowledge the sovereign's command
Activate responsibility assumption protocol wherein subject voluntarily realigns with witnessed dharma
Restore capacity for dharmic perception through guided awareness practices
Reintegrate integrity via ceremonial reaffirmation of alignment before the sovereign's witnessing presence
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma stands restored. The King embodies the living law whose gaze upholds cosmic order. There is no punishment—only correction through consciousness. Reality itself adjudicates through awareness.
